in_arabic.name: بحيرة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني البحيرة أو البركة الصغيرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم بحيرة هو اسم مؤنث عربي الأصل، يعني البحيرة أو البركة الصغيرة، وقد وردت كلمة بحيرة في القرآن الكريم في سورة يس، الآية 11، وبحيرة هي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و راقية.

in_urdu.name: بحیرہ
in_urdu.meaning: بحیرہ کا مطلب ہے ایک چھوٹا سا تالاب یا جھیل
in_urdu.long_meaning: بحیرہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ایک چھوٹا سا تالاب یا جھیل، جو پاکستانی اور ہندوستانی مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں ایک خوبصورت اور معانی سے بھرپور نام کے طور پر جانا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: बुहैरा
in_hindi.meaning: बुहैरा का अर्थ है एक छोटा तालाब या झील
in_hindi.long_meaning: बुहैरा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है एक छोटा तालाब या झील, जो भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, और यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम के रूप में जाना जाता है.

in_english.name: Buheirah

data.cultural_impact: The name "Buheirah" holds a deep cultural significance in Islamic societies due to its association with beauty and grace. In many Arab and Muslim communities, the notion of beauty is closely connected to the idea of God's divine creation. The name "Buheirah" is a reminder of the aesthetic marvels of the universe, and is considered an evocation of the artistic and ornamental dimensions of Islamic art, culture, and literature. This name holds a special place in Arabic and Islamic poetry and literature, often appearing in romantic and inspiring verses that celebrate the imaginative power of language and the sublime beauty of the natural world.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Buheirah" conveys a deeper meaning that goes beyond physical beauty and decoration. It is a reminder of the inner beauty and grace that all human beings possess, as taught by the Islamic faith. This inner beauty and grace are seen as expressions of God's divine presence and mercy, reflecting the Quranic verse, "We have honored the son of Adam." (Quran 17:70). The name "Buheirah" can be seen as a call to nurture and cultivate this inner beauty, striving to reflect God's perfection and elegance in our actions, words, and attitudes. By living in accordance with the moral and ethical teachings of Islam and upholding the values of compassion, kindness, and humility, we can aspire to embody the spiritual beauty and grace represented by this name.
